Umar Khalid Documentary Screenings Cancelled or Held Amidst Police Objections

Screenings of a documentary featuring Umar Khalid were cancelled in Pune and Nashik after police deemed the events "illegal." In contrast, a screening at NALSAR University proceeded despite an objection from the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC). NALSAR students reportedly held the screening to express solidarity.
